author: Grillribba
install_msg: SelfReactMute installed. Use `[p]selfreact show` to view the configuration.
name: SelfReactMute
short: Mutes members when they react to their own messages.
description: Configurable self-reaction moderation with a timed mute role and customizable embed notification.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild configuration and temporary mute expiration timestamps. It does not store personal data beyond Discord member IDs needed for active mute timers.
